en.headline: Basketballer Yang and wushu athlete Sham named Asian Games flag bearers
en.dek: Ivan Yang and Lydia Sham will lead the Hong Kong, China contingent into the opening ceremony in Nagoya on Saturday, the Sports Federation and Olympic Committee announced.
body: Basketball player Ivan Yang and wushu athlete Lydia Sham have been selected as flag bearers for the Hong Kong, China delegation at the opening ceremony of the 20th Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya.

The Sports Federation & Olympic Committee of Hong Kong, China named the pair on Thursday at a welcome ceremony in Nagoya. Chef de mission Wong Po-kee said the more than 800-strong contingent, including about 580 athletes across 38 sports, was fully prepared after long-term training.

Yang captained Hong Kong’s men’s under-22 team at the National Games and has represented the city in regional basketball competitions. Sham, competing in her third Asian Games, won gold in women’s changquan at the 2025 World Games and World Wushu Championships. Wong urged the public to support the athletes as they aim for new heights.

zh.headline: 亞運持旗手公布 楊博文沈曉榆領軍開幕
zh.dek: 籃球員楊博文及武術運動員沈曉榆獲選為香港代表團亞運開幕禮持旗手，體育總會周四在名古屋歡迎禮上宣布。
body: 中國香港體育協會暨奧林匹克委員會周四公布，籃球員楊博文及武術運動員沈曉榆將擔任第20屆亞運會開幕禮香港代表團持旗手。
代表團團長黃寶基在名古屋歡迎禮上表示，逾800人代表團（包括約580名運動員，出戰38個項目）經長期訓練已準備就緒，期望運動員享受比賽並爭取佳績。
楊博文曾擔任港隊男子U22隊長，並代表香港出戰亞洲籃球賽事；沈曉榆將第三度出戰亞運，去年在成都世運會及世界武術錦標賽女子長拳項目奪金。黃寶基呼籲市民支持運動員。
